title: Keyboard shortcuts read in one modifier order across the study
notes: Audit rescan 2026-08-23 found the same shortcut printed two ways: 59 pages write Cmd-Shift-H, 10 write Shift-Cmd-H, and the macOS screenshot shortcuts appear as Shift-Cmd-4/3/5 on app-shell, capture-wt and walk but Cmd-Shift-4 on home and ui-entry-wt. Option-Cmd-L and Cmd-Option-K split the same way. Pick ONE order for every shortcut hint (macOS renders Control, Option, Shift, Command in that order, which argues for Shift-Cmd) and sweep every .sc, .kbd and <code> hint in docs/design/mocks/pages plus AGENTS.md so the study never teaches two spellings of one key. Design-system family task took the majority spelling for its two pages as a stopgap.
